audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for divine jealousy, serpent deception, false apostles, unpaid ministry, angel of light, foolish boasting, hardship catalog, weakness boasting.

verses.restored: Would that you bear with me in a little foolishness; indeed, bear with me.

familiar.text: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

verses.restored: For I am jealous for you with Divine jealousy, for I betrothed you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Messiah.

familiar.text: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

verses.restored: But I fear lest somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in its craftiness, your thoughts might be corrupted from the simplicity and purity toward Messiah.

familiar.text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

verses.restored: For if the one coming proclaims another Jesus whom we did not proclaim, or you receive a different spirit which you did not receive, or a different good news which you did not accept, you bear with it beautifully/well.

familiar.text: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

verses.restored: For I calculate myself to have been in no way inferior to the super-apostles.

familiar.text: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

verses.restored: But even if unskilled in word, yet not in knowledge; indeed in every way we made this manifest among all to you.

familiar.text: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

verses.restored: Or did I sin/misalign by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I announced to you the good news of the Divine free of charge?

familiar.text: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?

verses.restored: I stripped/received support from other assemblies, taking wages for service toward you.

familiar.text: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

verses.restored: And being present with you and lacking, I burdened no one; for the siblings coming from Macedonia filled up my lack, and in everything I kept myself unburdensome to you and will keep.

familiar.text: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

verses.restored: Truth of Messiah is in me, that this boasting will not be sealed off from me in the regions of Achaia.

familiar.text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

verses.restored: Why? Because I do not love you? The Divine knows.

familiar.text: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

verses.restored: But what I do, I will also do, so that I may cut off opportunity from those desiring an opportunity, so that in what they boast they may be found just as we are.

familiar.text: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

verses.restored: For such ones are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into apostles of Messiah.

familiar.text: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

verses.restored: And no wonder; for the adversarial one transforms itself into a messenger of light.

familiar.text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

verses.restored: Therefore it is no great thing if its servants also transform themselves as servants of righteousness/justice, whose completion will be according to their works.

familiar.text: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

verses.restored: Again I say, let no one think me foolish; but if otherwise, receive me even as foolish, so that I also may boast a little.

familiar.text: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

verses.restored: What I speak, I do not speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

familiar.text: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

verses.restored: Since many boast according to flesh, I also will boast.

familiar.text: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

verses.restored: For gladly you bear with the foolish, being wise.

familiar.text: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

verses.restored: For you bear it if someone enslaves you, if someone devours, if someone takes, if someone lifts oneself up, if someone strikes you in the face.

familiar.text: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

verses.restored: I speak according to dishonor, as though we have been weak. But in whatever anyone dares, in foolishness I speak, I also dare.

familiar.text: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

verses.restored: Are they Hebrews? I also. Are they Israelites? I also. Are they seed of Abraham? I also.

familiar.text: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

verses.restored: Are they servants of Messiah? I speak as if out of my mind: I more; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in blows beyond measure, in deaths often.

familiar.text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

verses.restored: From Judeans five times I received forty lashes less one.

familiar.text: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

verses.restored: Three times I was beaten with rods; once I was stoned; three times I was shipwrecked; a night and day I have spent in the deep.

familiar.text: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

verses.restored: In journeys often, in dangers of rivers, dangers of robbers, dangers from my own people, dangers from nations, dangers in city, dangers in wilderness, dangers at sea, dangers among false siblings;

familiar.text: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

verses.restored: in labor and toil, in sleeplessness often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

familiar.text: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

verses.restored: Apart from the outer things, there is the daily pressure on me: the concern for all the assemblies.

familiar.text: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

verses.restored: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is made to stumble, and I do not burn?

familiar.text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

verses.restored: If it is necessary to boast, I will boast of the things of my weakness.

familiar.text: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

verses.restored: The Divine and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is blessed into the ages, knows that I am not lying.

familiar.text: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

verses.restored: In Damascus the ethnarch of Aretas the king was guarding the city of Damascenes to seize me,

familiar.text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

verses.restored: and through a window I was lowered in a basket through the wall and escaped his hands.

familiar.text: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

translation_notes: Paul's foolish boasting is ironic and defensive, contrasting exploitative status-apostles with weakness-bearing service.
The adversarial one as messenger of light is a discernment warning against deceptive spiritual appearance, not a license to demonize people.
